section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1997
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1997 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.5.8 Although break-up of total Government and Private vehicles is not available, it is interesting to note from Table - 8 that 93.5 percent victims of `Truck/Lorry', 63.9 percent of `Buses', 90.5 percent of `Tempo/Vans, 91.6% of `Jeeps' and 95.0 percent of cars, involved in accidents, were travelling in private vehicles.
